risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 206.56 crisis regime, CPI event in 2 days) creates severe near-term headwinds; earnings in 65 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + hull flip + three white soldiers form a textbook bullish technical setup with price near support (68.95), offering defined risk entry for mean reversion into resistance (71.81).
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch 81.1, Williams %R), weak ADX trend (17.2), zero fundamental conviction, macro crisis regime (VIX 206.56, inverted yield curve, CPI in 2 days), and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create a high-probability pullback environment that negates technical setup strength.

decision.primary_risk: Macro shock from CPI data in 2 days combined with VIX crisis regime and inverted yield curve will likely trigger sharp pullback before technical setup can resolve; overbought conditions offer no margin of safety.
